title: The Home page, next version — round 3: room brightness and media headers

steps.path: Pages → Home, a room's Lights card
steps.headline: Each room's Lights card has one brightness bar that sets every light in the room together, open or folded.
steps.changed: New, under the All row. It shows the lights that are on, averaged. Dragging sets every working dimmable light in the room, and turns on any that were off.
steps.notice: The lights follow while you drag, like the single bars. Lights that only switch on and off are left alone.
steps.risk: With every dimmable light off, the bar sits at its lowest point until you drag it.

steps.path: Pages → Home, the soundbar, speaker and TV cards
steps.headline: Media cards now start with a small type icon beside its label, the name flush left, and power or mute at top right.
steps.changed: The big icon square left of the name is gone. TVs keep their power button top right; soundbars and speakers lose on/off entirely and get a mute button there instead, which fills in while muted.
steps.notice: Muted, the card says Muted under the name and its volume bar dims.
steps.risk: A speaker that is truly switched off can no longer be switched on from here; playing music to it wakes it.
